paragraphs.text: Keep long DeepSeek Harness chats cheap and under control: fresh context in the same chat, rewind to
any prompt (chat and files), automatic compaction, recovery after failed turns, in one sidebar tab.
# dsh-conductor
Fresh context in the same chat, rewind to any prompt (chat and files), automatic compaction at your
level and recovery after failed turns, all in one sidebar tab.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Screenshot from a demo DSH instance with sample data.
**Keep long DeepSeek Harness chats cheap and under control.** `/new` gives a chat a fresh context in
place: the model writes a handoff from the full conversation, and that handoff becomes the whole hi
story. Same chat, same title, same pin, same position in the sidebar, same id for every script that
talks to it. Nothing is lost: the full transcript stays visible above and is archived as Markdown.
Around that: `/clear`, `/drop` single items out of the context, pins that survive every reset, messa
ge versions shown right in the chat, "ghosts" (silent messages between chats that never wake the rec
eiver, shown in the chat with a Ghost label), and multi-chat orchestration (agents, tasks, runners).
One plugin, one sidebar tab with five sub-tabs, three model tools.
| Ghosts and a v2 answer in the chat | /new in progress (Cancel keeps the context) | History: resets
and edits with a diff |
| Rewind: chat and files, with a preview of what comes back | Automation: level, scheduled /new, rel
ay, template, recovery |
## Why
Every request a chat sends carries its whole surviving history. A coordinator chat that has run for
a week sends hundreds of thousands of tokens per step, most of it stale tool output. Compaction help
s but keeps piling summaries on summaries; starting a new chat loses the chat's identity (scripts, p
ins, title, the place in the sidebar) and its accumulated context.
`/new` measured in the test lab: the first request after `/new` is the size of a brand new chat's fi
rst request plus the handoff (within 2K tokens), while the chat keeps its id, title and pins. The on
ly fixed cost left is what every chat pays anyway: system prompt, workspace instructions and tool de
ost left is what every chat pays anyway: system prompt, workspace instructions and tool definitions.
## Features
| | What it does | How |
| `/new [focus]` | Fresh context in the same chat from a model-written handoff | A compaction whose
summary is the handoff. One model call over the full context (reuses the provider cache); the handof

f is also saved as a file |
| `/clear` | Empty the model context, keep the chat | A compaction with

a short placeholder; no model call |
| `/force-compact [--pointer] [focus]` | Compact even past the
model window (from dsh-force-compact) | Map-reduce summary in parts that fit, or a mechanical checkp

oint with no model call |
| `/context` | What fills the context, largest items first | Reads the liv

e surface and the token meter |
| `/drop ...`, `/undrop` | Take tool outputs, messages or whole step
s out of the context, put them back | Surface replacements that cite the originals; the transcript a

nd a saved file keep them |
| `/pin`, `/unpin`, star button | Keep a message verbatim across every `

/new`, `/clear` and compaction | Side store; pins are re-added to every checkpoint |
| Versions | Ed
it a message or an answer (you or the model); the chat shows the current text with a "v2" marker, ev
ery version is kept with a diff | Surface replacement plus a version list; the chat renders through

its own message renderer |
| Ghosts: `/post`, `dsh-post`, `chats post` | Silent message into another
chat: shown there as a message with a Ghost label, read by its model on the next turn, never wakes

it | Appended notice the chat renders as a message; script API with a secret |
| `/checkpoint`, `/re
wind` | Go back to any earlier prompt: the conversation, the files the agent edited, or both; or con
tinue from there in a new chat | A checkpoint per prompt; pre-images of the agent's file edits in Co

nductor's own store (your git is never touched); the rewound part is archived |
| Automatic level (`
/auto level`) | The chat compacts, or hands off to a fresh context, by itself at the percentage of t
he model window you choose, after one heads-up to the model | Wraps the engine's pressure check with

a per-chat threshold |
[该节后续省略]
## How it works
- **In place, through core compaction.** `/new`, `/clear` and `/force-compact` call the chat's own `
/compact`. DSH's compaction engine keeps the locking, the events and the surface replacement; Conduc
tor only decides what the checkpoint says, through the engine's documented `summarize()` hook. Manua
l compaction replaces everything except the system prompt and the last answer, and DSH re-adds the w

orkspace instructions and runtime context on the next request (verified in the lab).
- **Checkpoints
use DSH's file hooks.** The agent's file tools announce every write and edit through DSH's file ser
vice; Conductor copies the file just before the first change in each turn. A rewind of the conversat

ion is the same kind of replacement as a drop, over everything after the checkpoint.
- **Nothing is
deleted.** DSH keeps an append-only log. Every change is a `replace` event that shadows earlier node
s and cites them. The chat transcript keeps showing the originals; archives and saved files keep the

m verbatim.
[该节后续省略]
## Security
- Browser routes: loopback peer, trusted Host, same-origin, JSON content type, `x-requested-with: ds

h-conductor` and the harness session cookie on every mutation. No GET mutates.
- Machine routes (`/r
emote/*`): secret only (`x-conductor-secret` or `Authorization: Bearer`), constant-time compare, rat

e limited, fail closed without a configured secret.
- Shell tasks and remote runners are off until y

ou enable them. The model cannot clear a chat or remove your pins unless you allow it.
- Known limit
: if DSH's session-log upload to the official DeepSeek API is enabled, dropped originals are still p
art of the log it uploads.
## Compatibility
Built and tested on DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 with dsh-better-sidebar 0.28.2. The plugin resolves every DSH pac
kage at run time and degrades with a clear warning when a seam is missing (no compaction engine: /ne
w and /clear report it; no Better Sidebar: no tab, everything else works).
